results.title: Your Personality Type
results.aiPlaceholder: AI-powered analysis coming soon! Connect to the backend to receive a personalized deep-dive into your personality type.

typeDescriptions.INTJ: Strategic and independent thinkers with a plan for everything. You see the world as a giant chess board, always thinking several moves ahead.
typeDescriptions.INTP: Innovative inventors with an unquenchable thirst for knowledge. You love exploring ideas and finding logical patterns.
typeDescriptions.ENTJ: Bold, imaginative leaders who always find a way. You're driven to organize and lead with strategic vision.
typeDescriptions.ENTP: Smart and curious thinkers who love intellectual challenges. You thrive on debates and exploring new possibilities.
typeDescriptions.INFJ: Quiet and mystical idealists who inspire others. You have a deep sense of purpose and seek meaning in everything.
typeDescriptions.INFP: Poetic, kind, and altruistic souls guided by values. You see the best in people and strive for harmony.
typeDescriptions.ENFJ: Charismatic and inspiring leaders who mesmerize others. You bring people together with warmth and vision.
typeDescriptions.ENFP: Enthusiastic, creative free spirits who find reason to smile. You see life as full of possibilities.
typeDescriptions.ISTJ: Practical and fact-minded individuals with reliability. You value tradition and are dedicated to duty.
typeDescriptions.ISFJ: Dedicated and warm protectors who are always ready to defend. You're loyal, considerate, and hardworking.
typeDescriptions.ESTJ: Excellent administrators with an unsurpassed ability to manage. You value order, structure, and tradition.
typeDescriptions.ESFJ: Extraordinarily caring, social, and popular people. You're attentive to others' feelings and eager to help.
typeDescriptions.ISTP: Bold and practical experimenters and masters of tools. You approach life with cool rationalism.
typeDescriptions.ISFP: Flexible and charming artists who explore with curiosity. You live in the moment with quiet enthusiasm.
typeDescriptions.ESTP: Smart, energetic, and perceptive people who live on the edge. You love action and solving problems.
typeDescriptions.ESFP: Spontaneous, energetic, and enthusiastic entertainers. Life is a stage and you love the spotlight.

iching.subtitle: Consult the ancient Book of Changes for wisdom and guidance.
iching.description: The I Ching (易经) is an ancient Chinese divination text dating back over 3,000 years. Through the casting of hexagrams, it reveals insights into your current situation and offers guidance for the path ahead.
iching.method: The oracle generates six lines — each either solid (Yang ━━━) or broken (Yin ━ ━). Some lines may be "changing," indicating transformation. Together they form a hexagram with profound meaning.
